speaker: Doctor
text:
I have noted your symptoms of fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes. These are concerning signs that require a thorough physical examination and some initial lab work to narrow down the possibilities.

REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count_with_Differential, Lactate_Dehydrogenase (LDH), and Erythrocyte_Sedimentation_Rate (ESR).
DIAGNOSIS READY: Cannot provide diagnosis without further information and test results; please wait for the return of your lab values.
